review.summary: GlnA performs the ammonium-entry reaction of the two-reaction GS-GOGAT cycle.
review.reason: The specific cycle term is supported by the accepted glutamine synthetase activity and the verified coupling of GlnA to the GltB/GltD glutamate-synthase reaction.

supported_by.supporting_text: A reusable bacterial module for high-affinity assimilation of ammonium through the glutamine synthetase-glutamate synthase (GS-GOGAT) cycle.

retired_proposals.reason: Withdraw this reviewer-authored duplicate proposal because the original nitrogen-utilization row is now correctly refined to GO:0019676 and the core retains the cycle. The biology remains accepted; this is neither a false-function REMOVE nor deletion of a GOA row.
